step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify external actors: Drawn stick figure icon on the far left represents an external end user (UserConsumerWeb).
2. Identify visual AWS component icons: ECS (labeled Web), API Gateway, Lambda, EC2 (labeled Modeling Endpoint), S3, Aurora (hand-drawn green database cylinder under Lambda), Amplify Framework, Cognito, and Pinpoint.
3. Trace connections: User connects to ECS web container. ECS calls API Gateway, which triggers Lambda. Lambda routes requests to the EC2 modeling endpoint, saves data to S3, and interacts with Aurora DB. Amplify framework underpins the front-end application connecting to Cognito for authentication and Pinpoint for analytics.
